The '''Maerdocia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Maerdocian sector/Legends|Maerdocian sector]], a part of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] regions known as the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]].<ref name="TEA" /> It shared its name with a [[Unidentified Maerdocian Senator|Maerdocian Senator]] of the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]].<ref name="SotP">''[[Specter of the Past]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Maerdocia system was established in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square Q-13.<ref name="TEA" />
